QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_47

question.text: Per current NSE/SEBI material and the NISM VII workbook footnote, when an equity option is exercised on or after April 1, 2026, STT is charged at:

answer.text: 0.125% on intrinsic value, payable by the buyer (applicable up to March 31, 2026)
0.15% on intrinsic value, payable by the buyer
0.02% on the notional value, payable by the buyer
No STT on exercise of options

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 117 of the current NISM VII workbook lists the option-exercise STT as 0.125% on intrinsic value payable by the buyer up to the workbook table date; footnote 53 flags that the rate is subject to change from April 1, 2026. Current exchange material shows the exercised-option STT rate from April 1, 2026 is 0.15% on intrinsic value, payable by the buyer. The Trap: 0.125% reflects the rate applicable up to March 31, 2026 — date-qualify the answer if needed. 0.02% on notional value is unrelated to the exercised-option STT. Cross-Exam Context: NISM VII, VIII, and X-B all test the April-1-2026 STT changes on option exercise and equity futures.
